events.body:
## Context

`test-sorting-security.js` checks the SQL sort-column allowlist and passes (21/21), and README and CONTRIBUTING tell people to run it, but the `test` script in `package.json` doesn't include it, so CI never does.

## What to do

1. Append `&& node test-sorting-security.js` to the `test` script; make sure it exits non-zero on failure.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm test` runs it
- [ ] A deliberately broken allowlist makes `npm test` fail

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-leaf
```

---
